title: Optimized Heaven
description: A lot af Optimization mods for a smooth experience
body:
🚀 Optimized Heaven (1.21.5) -
​The goal: Stop the lag, maximize FPS.
​This modpack is a pure performance overhaul for Minecraft 1.21.5. It uses the best modern optimizations (like Sodium) to give you massive frame rate boosts and eliminate stutters without adding any new blocks or items.
​It just makes your game run smoother than ever before.
